name: Spire Echo
description: A monolithic spire pulses with alien broadcast traffic. Inside, the ring's defense AI has been assimilated. The operative must shut down the spire before it summons reinforcements across all 16 maps.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Spire Echo is broadcasting on 47 frequencies. It's calling every alien construct within signal range. We have minutes before the ring lights up like a Christmas tree.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: The outer ring is inert. The assimilation wave originates from the core. Do not touch the cables.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Antenna offline. The broadcast dropped 34%. But the core is still pulsing.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: Assimilation wave neutralized. The spire is blind. Now destroy the core before it reboots.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Spire core destroyed. The ring's defense grid is down. We bought the operatives a clean window.

easter_eggs.name: CE Release Bug
easter_eggs.description: Fourth-wall break: the game acknowledges it is a build with known issues.
